details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: denial of service through quadratic runtime in the
     default-attribute lookup performed by storeAtts()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66046.patch: resolve the CDATA-ness of a
       specified attribute through the per-element defaultAttForName hash
       table instead of a linear scan of defaultAtts, and fold in the
       upstream follow-up that makes dtdCopy create entries of the same
       size so storeAtts does not read .attIndex out of bounds (libexpat
       PR #1321, PR #1331).
     - CVE-2026-66046
   * SECURITY UPDATE: malformed UTF-16 accepted because a high surrogate was
     not required to be followed by a low surrogate
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-93990.patch: reject a 4-byte UTF-16 sequence
       whose second code unit is not a low surrogate, in both the little2_
       and big2_ tokenizers (libexpat PR #1282).
     - CVE-2026-93990
